title: Contact form with validation
prompt:
Build a contact page at /contact.

Requirements:
- A heading "Contact us".
- Fields labelled "Name", "Email" and "Message" (the message is a multi-line field).
- A button "Send message".
- Pressing it with an empty Name shows the error "Name is required" and sends nothing.
- With Name, a valid Email and Message filled in, pressing it shows "Thanks, we will reply soon".
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.
